rationale: Comprehensive code path audit from Core Arrival forecast through synthetic turnaround to solvers (Greedy, CP-SAT, CP-SAT+SA) establishes that downstream optimization operates exclusively on deterministic scalar time windows [start_min, end_min). Neither Flight domain objects nor CP-SAT/SA/Greedy solvers consume distributions, variances, quantiles, or risk buffers. P5 quantile regression passes strictly its median q50 scalar; all other quantiles and intervals are discarded. P4 Student-T passes strictly its predictive mean; scale, degrees of freedom, and tail distributions are discarded. Monte Carlo evaluates independent scalar realizations rather than stochastic programming. Therefore, the pipeline is strictly a forecast-derived scalar operational impact benchmark, and locking semantics to SCALAR_FORECAST_IMPACT prevents unverified claims of uncertainty-aware optimization.
forbidden_claims: Uncertainty-aware optimization or stochastic gate assignment
Distributional gate allocation or chance-constrained gate optimization
Downstream propagation of predictive variance, quantiles, or tail risk
Real-world gate assignment or physical airport delay reductions at ATL
Continuous distribution capabilities for P5 quantile regression
Oracle as a learned or deployable prediction model
required_terminology: P5 evaluated strictly in forecast-only median mode (q50)
P4 evaluated downstream via point mean delay
Oracle designated strictly as non-deployable reference arm
next_actions: Lock downstream semantics across all registry manifests, tests, and documentation.
Maintain P4 and P5 probabilistic evaluations strictly at the upstream forecast evaluation layer.
Enforce test assertions preventing unapproved stochastic claims in downstream evaluations.
Proceed to R18 post-freeze audit upon verified pass of R17.
